title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Buster Busts Loose! - Before Cafeteria
description:
This is seen before Buster enters the cafeteria to fight Dizzy. I made the BG loop properly and added 1 extra Map16 tile to fix it. Originally, it was over 256x192 tiles. You can leave it like in the BG. It will display properly in-game. If you do change the back area color, then change the color of the clouds and the blue houses' roof.

Have fun!
